status: exploratory: written after the first UC-03 run (verdict inconclusive), before any correction was run on data

distance.source: Baumgardt globular cluster database v4 (Mar. 2023), parameter table, NGC 6205; distances mostly from Baumgardt & Vasiliev 2021, MNRAS, doi 10.1093/mnras/stab1474 (arXiv 2105.09526)

distance_alternative.source: Harris 1996, AJ 112, 1487, December 2010 revision, NGC 6205 R_Sun

light.source: Baumgardt globular cluster database v4, NGC 6205: mass 4.84e5 +- 0.06e5 M_sun and M/L_V 2.05 +- 0.08, so L_V = mass / (M/L_V), at the database distance

degenerate_note: added in 1.1.0 after the first UC-03b run, whose 6 arcmin fits slid to a of 0.06-0.94 pc: a fit with a below 0.2 r_in sees only the power-law tail and is listed, not counted
